title: AI and the Division of Labor in Public Sector Jobs and Teams
abstract: arXiv:2512.05659v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: How artificial intelligence (AI) affects an organization depends not only on which jobs are exposed, but on how more (versus less) exposed tasks are combined within roles. Using 283,484 UK Civil Service vacancies, we extract 2.7 million tasks and estimate their automation potential with an ensemble of eight foundation models. We find that differences among tasks within roles account for 65.3 percent of total exposure variance, while profession and grade together explain only 4.0 percent, suggesting that seemingly similar roles often differ substantially in their exposure and potential for redesign. Combining roles' mean exposure with their within-role dispersion distinguishes where workforce adjustment, job redesign, targeted task automation, or limited intervention may be most relevant. translated_title: AI与公共部门职位和团队中的劳动分工
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）对一个组织的影响不仅取决于哪些职位暴露于AI，还取决于暴露程度较高（相对较低）的任务在角色内部如何组合。利用283,484个英国公务员职位空缺数据，我们提取了270万个任务，并使用八个基础模型的集成来估计它们的自动化潜力。我们发现，角色内部任务之间的差异占总暴露方差的65.3%，而职业和职级合计仅解释了4.0%，这表明看似相似的角色在AI暴露程度和重新设计潜力上往往存在显著差异。将角色的平均暴露程度与角色内部离散度相结合，可以区分哪些场景下劳动力调整、职位重新设计、有针对性的任务自动化或有限干预最为适用。考虑到随着AI扩展到某个角色时哪些任务可能发生变化，我们在角色和团队层面模拟了重新设计。角色重新设计削减了行政……
tldr: 该研究基于英国28万多个公务员职位空缺中的270万个任务发现，AI暴露度差异主要由角色内部任务构成决定（占65.3%）而非职业和职级（仅占4.0%），并通过角色和团队层面的重新设计模拟，为劳动力调整、职位再设计和有针对性的任务自动化提供了指导。
en_tdlr: Using 283,484 UK Civil Service vacancies and 2.7 million extracted tasks, this study finds that within-role task differences explain 65.3% of AI exposure variance (versus only 4.0% for profession and grade), and simulates role- and team-level redesign to inform workforce adjustment, job redesign, and targeted task automation.
